description: Extreme climate events overwhelm institutions and expose weak preparedness.
Ecosystem degradation approaches thresholds with irreversible or hard-to-reverse consequences.
Adaptation resources protect privileged groups while vulnerable communities face exposure.
Green technologies reduce some pressures while shifting extraction labor and governance risks.
Transition investment reinforces inequality displacement extraction and weak labor protection.
Place-based resilience remains underfunded despite ecological and community benefits.
Coordinated transition weakens when institutions lose alignment or public trust.
Ambitious sustainability transformation faces backlash if legitimacy participation and fairness are weak.
